paper.title: Asymptotic Optimality of the High-Dimensional Gaussian Mechanism and Improved Low-Dimensional Mechanisms for Differential Privacy

claims.production: Structured symbolic derivation plus finite-T calibration over 256 dimension/epsilon/radial-law configurations.
claims.result: 12-step derivation passes; worst finite-T calibration gap is 2.697e-4.

claims.production: Universal Haar/isometry and joint-convexity certificate plus 56 exact finite C4-group cases and mutated-assumption controls.
claims.result: Certificate passes; 56/56 finite cases pass; three negative controls reject.

claims.production: Five adaptive normalization integrals, Gaussian and l2 identities, and a factor-p negative control.
claims.result: Maximum normalization error 3.55e-15; special cases pass.

claims.production: Deterministic common-random-number and independent scrambled-Sobol QMC calibrations of published existence configurations.
claims.boundary: Raw paper coordinates and optimizer settings are unpublished.

claims.production: Analytic tangent slopes, convex tails, and tangent dominance are checked for all seven printed thresholds with rounding slack.
claims.result: 7/7 rows pass; delta=0.9 negative control fails as expected.

claims.production: Paper-faithful FFT accountant is compared with direct computation in the Figure 3 regime and a 72-case broad sweep.
claims.result: Figure 3 reductions rise 31.4% to 94.3%; direct/FFT agreement reaches 7.37e-18.
